3 Study the examples and choose the correct options.
Check your answers in the Grammar box and Watch out!
Direct questions ___ Reported questions
Did you audition last year? They asked if /'d auditioned
theyear before:
Where are you from? ___ They wanted to know where
was from ___
When we report questions, we usually use tell / ask
want to know as the reporting verb:
When we report yes/no questions wh- questions, we
use ifor whether.
3 When we report questions, the subject comes before
after the verb. We use don'tuse auxiliary verbs (do, does,
did):
When we write reported questions, we use don't use
question mark:
Reported questions
Direct questions ___ Reported questions
Yes/No questions
Do you need anything? They kept asking me if/whether
needed anything:
Have we met before? ___ She wanted to know if/whether
we had met before:
Wh- questions
Why is it called the ___ asked them why it was called
green room? ___ the green room:
Where haveyou been? They wanted to know where
Ihad been ___

WATCH OUT!
When we report questions, we do not use question word
order: In reported questions, the subject comes before
the verb.
Iasked them why it was called the green room:
NOT Fasked-themn why was it-called-the gfeen fo0fn .

to ask a classmate about their hobby; talent or skill
